title: Conflict Predictor
description: Proactive conflict detection between worktrees and branches

result.noConflicts: No conflicts detected - safe for parallel development!

waves.title: Execution waves
waves.description: Groups the specs waiting in the backlog or queue into waves that share no file, from their plans and what their worktrees already changed. No model is called.

options.toleranceHint: Pairs whose score is at or below this value may share a wave.
options.advanceReview: once the wave is in review
options.fragileHint: Files the last commits changed together, one in each spec, add to the pair's score.
options.codeHint: A file of one spec importing a module the other edits, or using a symbol the other removes, adds to the pair's score.

empty.noProject: Select a project to plan its waves.
empty.noPlan: Compute the waves to see which specs can run side by side.
empty.noTasks: No spec is waiting in the backlog or queue.

gantt.title: Plan
gantt.legend: Each bar is a spec in its wave; the waves run one after the other, the specs of a wave side by side. No duration is estimated.

list.title: Waves
list.mergeHint: Merge in this order: the first spec shares the most with the next waves.

run.stopped: Run stopped at wave {{current}} of {{total}}. Running tasks keep going.

notices.cycle: Dependency cycle, cannot be planned without you: {{tasks}}
notices.blockedByCycle: Waiting on a spec of a cycle: {{tasks}}
notices.drift: {{task}} touched {{count}} files outside its plan. Replan?
notices.unplanned: {{count}} specs have no plan yet: their footprint is unknown.

mergeCheck.split: {{a}} and {{b}} are under the tolerance, but a test merge of their worktrees conflicts on {{files}}: they run in different waves.
mergeCheck.summary: Test merges of the pairs sharing a wave: {{checked}} checked, {{conflicts}} split. Only committed work is merged; no worktree or branch is changed.
mergeCheck.unchecked: {{count}} pairs sharing a wave were not test-merged (limit reached).
mergeCheck.failed: Git could not test-merge {{count}} pairs (no common history, or git older than 2.38).

resume.title: A run was interrupted at wave {{current}} of {{total}} (saved {{savedAt}}). Tasks already started kept going.
resume.ignored: A run saved in this project could not be read or no longer matches its tasks: it was ignored.

fragile.summary: Fragile zones: files changed together in the last {{commits}} commits add to the scores.
fragile.unavailable: Fragile zones: git could not read the project's history; scores use shared files only.

code.summary: Code links: {{count}} files read for imports and removed symbols, in any language.
code.capped: The file limit was reached: some files were not read.

history.summary: Last {{days}} days: {{runs}} runs ended ({{stopped}} stopped), {{conflicts}} conflicts avoided (risk {{risk}} taken out), {{started}} specs started.
history.ignored: The run history of this project could not be read: it starts again with the next run.
